title: Captain Joe Mendez
specs: Fishing on shallow flats of Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, and Land Cut
Use of 23' Shoal-Water Cat boat with Mercury 300 Pro engine for conventional fishing
Use of 18' Curlew boat with Mercury 115 HP engine for fly fishing
Over 25 years of guiding experience by Captain Joe Mendez
United States Coast Guard licensed Captain
Texas Parks and Wildlife licensed guide
Participation in USCG drug testing program
Waders recommended for colder months when wading
Wading boots needed for warmer months when wading
includes: All tackle, bait, ice, and fishing cleaning
Fishing rods and reels including Shimano spinning and bait-casting reels for conventional fishing
Fly fishing rods and reels including Thomas & Thomas Horizon Saltwater Series Rods and Abel Reels
blurb: Captain Joe Mendez offers guided fishing charters on the shallow flats of Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, and the Land Cut targeting redfish, speckled trout, and other species. Trips include both conventional and fly fishing options, with all tackle and gear provided. Wading trips are also available in shallow, clear waters.
extraNote: Trips generally start at sunrise depending on weather · Bring your own food and drinks · Year-round with mild winters
